_readme: SHARED GOLDEN FIXTURE — spec §8. Byte-identical duplicate in BOTH prep/tests/fixtures/ and template/tests/fixtures/. INDUSTRY_TAG_TO_BUCKET decides which bucket phrase a record's prompt uses; if prep and template disagree, the eval asks a DIFFERENT question than the one the evidence was recorded against, and the >= 0.8 bar absorbs it as noise. Asserted by prep's test_scenarios.py and template's prompts.test.ts. EDIT BOTH COPIES OR NEITHER.

_groups.tag_bucket_cases: direct INDUSTRY_TAG_TO_BUCKET lookup — scenario-free, the table is flat. BOTH sides run EVERY case.
_groups.unmapped_tag_default_cases: a tag in NO bucket falls back to the scenario's default bucket (DOMAIN_BUCKETS[scenario][0] prep-side). The default is SCENARIO-SCOPED, hence the extra `scenario` field — and hence an asymmetry the template cannot avoid: prep owns DOMAIN_BUCKETS for BOTH scenarios, but the template's generated `DOMAIN_BUCKETS: readonly string[]` (spec §8:4007) is FLAT — the winning scenario's five phrases only, because goal #10 ships exactly one scenario. `prompts.test.ts` therefore runs ONLY the case whose `scenario` matches the shipped one, and skips the other; prep's test_scenarios.py runs both. §14:5782's 'reproduces every case' is true for tag_bucket_cases and, for this group, true of every case the template can express. Flagged for an orchestrator ruling.

unmapped_tag_default_cases.note: Not in INDUSTRY_TAG_TO_BUCKET at all -> DOMAIN_BUCKETS['A'][0].
Same unmapped tag, other scenario -> DOMAIN_BUCKETS['B'][0]. This pair is why the default cannot be expressed without a scenario.
